name: CommaFeed
description: A fast Google Reader style RSS reader for your server

paths.name: Data
paths.description: CommaFeed's H2 database with users, feeds and articles, plus the session key. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: CommaFeed web app and API, published on host as 6887

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: COMMAFEED_USERS_ALLOW_REGISTRATIONS
variables.description: true lets anyone who can open CommaFeed make their own account. false means only the admin adds users.

variables.name: COMMAFEED_HTTP_CLIENT_BLOCK_LOCAL_ADDRESSES
variables.description: true stops CommaFeed from fetching feeds on your home network (a safety rule). Set false to read feeds from other apps on your MOS, like FreshRSS or RSS-Bridge.
